definitions.gloss: entry into a country; immigration (at a border)
definitions.explanation: The act of entering a country, particularly the formal process of passing through immigration control at an airport or border crossing.

examples.japanese: {入国|にゅうこく}{審査|しんさ}に{時間|じかん}がかかった。
examples.english: The immigration inspection took a long time.

examples.japanese: ビザなしで{入国|にゅうこく}できる{国|くに}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: The number of countries you can enter without a visa is increasing.

examples.japanese: {空港|くうこう}に{着|つ}いたら、まず{入国|にゅうこく}{管理|かんり}のカウンターに{並|なら}んでください。
examples.english: When you arrive at the airport, first line up at the immigration counter.

notes:
GRAMMAR:
{入国|にゅうこく}する is used as a する verb meaning "to enter a country."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入国|にゅうこく}{審査|しんさ} (immigration inspection)
- {入国|にゅうこく}{管理|かんり}{局|きょく} (immigration bureau)
- {入国|にゅうこく}ビザ (entry visa)
- {入国|にゅうこく}{拒否|きょひ} (refusal of entry)
- {入国|にゅうこく}カード (arrival/disembarkation card)

CONTRAST:
{入国|にゅうこく} (entering a country) vs. {出国|しゅっこく} (leaving a country) — these form a natural pair.
